column7: The implementation of TA2.41, which aims to achieve cumulative end-use energy savings, may reinforce TA3.3, which aims to double the EU's circular material use rate, as increased energy efficiency can lead to reduced material consumption and waste generation, thus supporting the transition to a more circular economy.

The implementation of TA2.21, which aims to reduce the total final energy consumption of public bodies, may constrain TA3.15, which requires producers of batteries to take back waste batteries free of charge, as the reduced energy consumption may lead to decreased battery demand and subsequently affect the collection and recycling targets.

The implementation of TA2.22, which aims to reduce energy consumption, may constrain TA3.16, which sets collection targets for waste portable batteries, as reduced energy consumption may lead to decreased battery demand and subsequently affect the collection and recycling targets.

The implementation of TA2.23, which aims to limit primary energy consumption, may constrain TA3.17, which sets collection targets for waste LMT batteries, as reduced energy consumption may lead to decreased battery demand and subsequently affect the collection and recycling targets.

The implementation of TA2.25, which aims to reduce buildings' final energy consumption, may constrain TA3.20, which sets recycling targets for batteries, as reduced energy consumption may lead to decreased battery demand and subsequently affect the recycling targets.

The implementation of TA2.26, which aims to double the annual energy renovation rate, may constrain TA3.21, which sets recycling targets for lithium-based batteries, as increased renovation rates may lead to reduced energy consumption and subsequently affect the recycling targets.

The implementation of TA2.40, which aims to decarbonize steel production, may counteract TA3.30, which aims to reduce packaging waste, as the increased use of renewable energy sources and raw materials may lead to increased packaging waste generation.

The implementation of TA2.41 may enable TA3.31, which aims to increase recycling targets for packaging waste, as increased energy efficiency and reduced energy consumption may lead to reduced packaging waste generation, thus supporting the transition to a more circular economy.

The implementation of TA2.17, which aims to increase electricity interconnection, may cancel TA3.11, which aims to diversify imports of strategic raw materials, as increased interconnection may lead to increased reliance on imported energy sources and subsequently affect the diversification of raw material imports.
